description: Full-pipeline acceptance from a FROZEN single-scenario spec via the real `/run-pipeline` command. The command plans SCENARIO-01 (architect), implements it with TDD (developer) in the framework-free golden repo, runs the reviewers, and applies its own fix-loop. Orchestration is the command's, not the harness's. Acceptance = the objective signal: the build compiles and tests pass, AND an INDEPENDENT reviewer pass (run by the harness, not trusting the command) finds zero must-fix VIOLATIONs. WARNING/SUGGESTION are reported but non-gating (refactor-advisor always finds a suggestion). The spec scopes HTTP/persistence out so the chain stays on the framework-free core.
